anchoredLines.line: 🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Willie. Hummice, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 3 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Fatima Rossi. From Emberhold." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
🌪️ THE HERALD fed in the night — 1,610 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Stonebridge answers! Talia Weiss and Ibrahim Kim will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! June Hassan and Felix Adeyemi will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— The Bloodied answers! Nora Dubois and Marcus Nakamura will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)

🛡️ Elijah steps forward. They will march with the muster, eat from your stores (1000 kcal/day each), and stand in front of THE HERALD. They can die — Haven does not get them back, and the fire will be quieter. Tap again — Haven sends its own.
🛡️ Haven commits its own: Elijah marches with the muster. Not loaned. Not asked-for. Ours. The coalition counts 7 blades against THE HERALD — it needs 10.
